name: Brand compliance terms ledger
howToUse: Every OEM / co-op / legal review finding about wording becomes a row here. The build gate 'Brand terms ledger' fails the build when a rule with severity 'fail' matches the article copy, titles, meta, image alt text or slug/path; 'warn' rules print an advisory. The compliance reviewer agent also checks this file. Add new rows with the next id for the brand, the exact source and the date.

rules.scope: all copy, headings, buttons, titles, meta, alt text, URLs/slugs, file names
rules.reason: Mercedes-Benz OEM advertising review fails the word "coupon".
rules.source: Client OEM compliance review relayed by Nasko, 10/09/2026. Supporting: Mercedes-Benz USA Brand Communication Standards Rev.10 (Aug 2015) p.6 lists "Coupon" among terms dealers may not use (public copy: https://retrocdn.net/images/0/08/MercedesBenz_BrandCommunicationStandards_2015-08-20.pdf); current standards are login-only (MBUSA dealer portal).

rules.use: "TSRP" (Total Suggested Retail Price: MSRP + distributor-installed options + delivery, processing and handling), with the region's TSRP disclaimer; never label a TSRP figure "MSRP"
rules.scope: all copy, tables, headings, titles, meta, alt text
rules.reason: Toyota price references use TSRP, not MSRP.
rules.source: Client OEM compliance guidance relayed by Nasko, 10/09/2026. Supporting: Southeast Toyota window sticker "TOTAL SUGGESTED RETAIL PRICE" (https://sync.dealeralchemist.com/ddoa/monroney/5TDYRKEC4TS326778); Toyota dealer sites use TSRP since ~10/2023. Note: toyota.com model pages still say "Starting MSRP" (https://www.toyota.com/camry/). Toyota Dealer Advertising Covenant (TDAC) is login-only.
rules.confidence: HIGH (client rule; Nasko 10/09: always TSRP for every Toyota dealer)

rules.use: neutral wording; describe the actual offer
rules.reason: MBUSA standards ban distress wording in dealer advertising.
rules.source: MBUSA Brand Communication Standards Rev.10 (2015) p.6/p.20 (public copy above); current version login-only

rules.use: avoid; articles carry no dealer pricing
rules.reason: MBUSA standards list these among terms dealers may not use.
rules.source: MBUSA Brand Communication Standards Rev.10 (2015) p.6

rules.use: remove, or cite the substantiating source in the copy
rules.reason: MBUSA requires substantiation and a source disclaimer for superlatives.
rules.source: MBUSA Brand Communication Standards Rev.10 (2015) p.20

research: Sources and open questions: SALES_ARTICLES/2026.10.09-COMPLIANCE-TERMS-LEDGER.md (project). OEM ad standards / co-op portals are login-only (MBUSA, Toyota TDAC, Ansira co-op for Ford/Honda, Mazda co-op): ask the client for current PDFs to replace 2015 citations.
